messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High request rate detected for model family astra-3b - 95% of dedicated TPM reserved capacity in us-east-1.

sara: I'm on it. seeing tail-latency spikes and a lot of 429s from the rate-limiter. Any customer-reported outages?

mike: Customer-facing alerts from cust-4723 and cust-9812 started ~10m ago. They're reporting timeout retries. Not full outages but elevated error rate.

riley: quick context — astra-3b rollout last week; we bumped baseline TPM for hosted tier 2. Looks like traffic pattern changed (short chattiness). We should sculpt per-model TPM/RPM rather than broad account throttles.

sara: Agreed. Plan: scale down astra-3b TPM for hosted tiers by 30% as immediate mitigation, enable tenant-specific adaptive shaping for the two impacted customers, monitor 10m, then iterate.

jordan: I can run the change. Confirming exact numbers — current TPM=2000 RPM=6000 for astra-3b on hosted. Proposed TPM=1400 RPM=4200?

sara: let's do TPM=1500 RPM=4500 (conservative). Also enable prefix KV caching for short prompts for 60s TTL.

mike: applying now. Using trafficctl (internal):

```
trafficctl set-quota --model astra-3b --region us-east-1 --tpm 1500 --rpm 4500 --reason "live mitigation: tail 429s"
trafficctl enable-shaping --tenant cust-4723 --model astra-3b --policy adaptive-burst
trafficctl enable-shaping --tenant cust-9812 --model astra-3b --policy adaptive-burst
```

natalie: executed. API responded OK. Pushed config to edge routers, rolling to 6 nodes.

incident-bot: Deployment note: quota change job 8921 succeeded on 4/6 nodes, pending on 2 nodes. Rolling: 66% complete.

sara: good. Jordan, can you add a temporary alert to catch >5% 5xx for those tenants and escalate to incidents@ if hit?

jordan: added. Alert name: oncall/tenant-5xx-cust-4723-9812 (window 5m, threshold 5%).

riley: initial telemetry — 429s dropped by ~40% at edge, latency 95p improved ~120ms. Some request queuing now but overall success rate up for other models.

mike: Customer update drafted: "We've implemented temporary traffic shaping for astra-3b to stabilize latency. We're monitoring and will follow up with timeline for permanent fix." Want me to send to their CSMs?

sara: yes, send. Include note that we may revert if no improvement.

natalie: handoff — my shift ends in 18m. Sara will take primary oncall. Riley will be backup.

sara: taking handoff. TL;DR: lowered astra-3b TPM/RPM in us-east-1, enabled adaptive shaping for cust-4723/9812, alerts in place. Continue to watch errors and rollback window in ~30m if stable.

incident-bot: Thread closed by sara. Please acknowledge by reacting :white_check_mark: if you have context.

mike: :white_check_mark:

riley: :white_check_mark:

jordan: :white_check_mark:

natalie: :white_check_mark:
